0x1B4.name: segmentCount
0x1B4.evidence: AllocRingGeometry steps the angle by 0x1.921fb p+2 (2*pi) / field_1B4, loops sin/cos field_1B4 times per ring, and the vertex count per ring is 2*field_1B4+2.
0x1B4.summary: number of segments around the ring

0x1B5.name: ringLevelCount
0x1B5.evidence: AllocRingGeometry allocates 36*(2*segments+2)*field_1B5 bytes, builds field_1B5 colours from the 4-byte entries at +0x1A4, and draws field_1B5-1 triangle strips.
